# PULSE

Canonical discovery: OKX.AI agent #8355 on X Layer; CDP Bazaar on Base and Arbitrum; Circle Agent Marketplace listing material on Arc Testnet. The execution-mainnet catalog has eight services: five analysis/risk services and Start Autopilot for 24h ($1.50), 7d ($10.50), or 30d ($45.00). Circle/Arc exposes only the five analysis/risk services because Arc Testnet has no Spot or Autopilot execution.

PULSE provides first-class Global Market and Prediction Market intelligence, connected-wallet Spot execution, Onchain Pre-Trade Risk Guard, and a separate guarded Autopilot workflow for humans and AI agents. The eight execution-mainnet services are Global Quick → Spot Market or Limit ($0.20), Global Pro → Spot Market or Limit ($0.30), Prediction Quick ($0.20), Prediction Pro ($0.30), Onchain Pre-Trade Risk Guard ($0.15), Start Autopilot · 24h ($1.50), Start Autopilot · 7d ($10.50), and Start Autopilot · 30d ($45.00). Global reports can prefill Spot Market or Limit orders. Autopilot instead starts directly from its own pair, strategy, capital, risk and duration; it uses the caller's Agentic Wallet for visible state-changing signatures, deterministic candidate gates and compact prepaid AI confirmation without buying a Global report. Pause freezes paid runtime. Polymarket remains read-only.
